fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-11-14, a rented premises near Vaigai Layout Market Road in Tiruppur was allegedly occupied by a person after the lease ended, and the keys were not returned. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-11-13 at about 09:45. The complaint was lodged by Dinesh Nathan (9000000420). The complaint refers to Gunasekar Anand, a neighbour, reachable on 9000000050. Chithra Kannan (mobile 9000000146) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant mentioned physical documents and photographs. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00224, as the mobile number 9000000146 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Occupant reportedly refused to vacate despite repeated requests.
fields.Keywords: illegal occupation, lease dispute, mobile number, documents, morning, market road, associate, suspect
